name: kondi-x-mcp
description: MCP server providing X (Twitter) API tools

tools.name: x_post_tweet
tools.description: Post a new tweet to X (Twitter). Optionally reply to an existing tweet.

tools.name: x_get_tweet
tools.description: Get a single tweet by ID with optional field expansions.

tools.name: x_get_user_tweets
tools.description: Get recent tweets from a user by their user ID.

tools.name: x_search_tweets
tools.description: Search recent tweets matching a query.
